associations.originalReading:
19 JULY 1965                      The Third Battalion, Ninth Marines was redesignated
                                  the Second Battalion, Fifth Marines.  Lieutenant
                                  Colonel C. E. MC PARTLIN, Jr., was the Commanding
                                  Officer.

associations.event: McPartlin relieved by Ram; staff and company assignments
associations.originalReading:
19 AUGUST 1965                    Lieutenant Colonel C. E. MC PARTLIN, Jr., was re-
                                  lieved as Commanding Officer by Captain C. H. RAM.
                                  The following billets were filled on this date:

                                  S-1:    First Lieutenant T. BOYD
                                  S-2:    First Lieutenant E. A. KRATOVIL, Jr.
                                  S-4:    Captain H. C. WINCH
                                  CO, H&SCo: First Lieutenant P. C. ROLLINS
                                  CO, "E"Co: First Lieutenant T. R. MINOR
                                  CO, "F"Co: First Lieutenant D. G. WINTER
                                  CO, "G"Co: First Lieutenant D. H. EERING
                                  CO, "H"Co: First Lieutenant J. J. DOHERTY
